categories_thin: Therapists / mental-health counseling: still thin. Individual clinicians rarely publish a street address, one Old Bridge practice (HER Heart) turns out to be telehealth-only, and Psychology Today/Zencare listings either block fetching or give no address, so only three counseling entities could be placed at a local address (Thrive, Innerspace, Jafri).

Primary care / family medicine: no additions were possible. The Old Bridge practices found this round are branded health-system sites (Hackensack Meridian primary care at 3 Hospital Plaza and 42 Throckmorton Lane; RWJPE Old Bridge Family Medicine at 2107 Highway 516), which the rules exclude, so independent PCPs remain unrepresented.

Med spas / aesthetics: one directory-only addition (Bombshell) was the only new find; the rest advertise mainly on Instagram with no indexable listing, so this category is probably still undercounted.

Barbers, hair and nail salons: BestProsInTown and the salon directories expose addresses but strip many business names, Google Maps without sign-in returns only a handful of results per query, and YellowPages/Booksy/Fresha listing pages block or JS-render. One new salon (House of Medusa) was added from its own site.
Endodontics and independent optometry were thin in the first pass; both are now covered (Mid Jersey Endodontic Group, Reel Optics).
Laurence Harbor: no group-B business there was listed; the area is roughly 10.2 miles from Milltown center and appears to be just outside the radius.
caveats: Exclusion rule applied in this revision (stated so it is applied consistently): excluded are franchise/licence brands (Ellie Mental Health, SWEAT440, Powerhouse Gym), brand chains and multi-office groups of roughly 5+ outlets under one brand (NUVA Smile at 25 NJ offices; Satori Academy at 8 NJ schools plus Staten Island), and health-system-owned practices. Kept: independent owner-run practices and local groups with 2-5 offices, with the office count noted (ProFysio 5, Dermatology Associates of Central NJ 4, Mid Jersey Endodontic Group multi-office). Removed on that basis: Ellie Mental Health, SWEAT440, NUVA Smile, Satori Academy, Powerhouse Gym.

Old Bridge Dental is kept but flagged: it operates under its own single-office brand while its site names Dental Care Alliance, LLC (a national dental support organisation) as parent. If the owner treats DSO-supported practices as chains, this entry should be dropped too.

Winter Wellness (acupuncture) was removed: the clinic's own site now publishes 1 Main Street, Sayreville, NJ 08872, i.e. outside this Old Bridge zone. The 499 Marlboro Rd address came only from aggregator sites and is not supported by the clinic.
Proper Iron (formerly Jersey Strong Old Bridge) is in transition; its new page publishes no phone, so the phone field is 'Unknown' rather than carrying over the old Jersey Strong number.

Old Bridge Township is a large, sprawling township addressed variously as Old Bridge, Parlin, Matawan and Laurence Harbor; entries keep the mailing town used by the listing, and Parlin/Matawan-address entries near Old Bridge Gateway or Route 34 were kept when the listing placed them in Old Bridge Township.

Also excluded on purpose as chains, franchises or health systems: Supercuts, European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Sugaring NYC, Phenix Salon Suites, MY SALON Suite, Diamond Braces, America's Best Contacts & Eyeglasses, Kessler Rehabilitation Center, JAG Physical Therapy, Hackensack Meridian and RWJBarnabas practices, Beach Bum Tanning, Sally Beauty, GNC.

Phones come from whichever listing showed one (own site, directories, map listings); several entries have 'Unknown' rather than a guess. No phone number was estimated, and the Old Bridge Dental number was corrected to the practice's own published line.
A few entries (RJ Aesthetics, L'Soul Nails Bar, HER Heart, Black Velvet Hair Lounge) lack a street address because no source published one.
njtgo.com is a single third-party township directory of recent vintage; businesses found only there are marked 'one bulk directory listing' and should be confirmed by triage.

Inferences are labelled as such: the DSO reading of Old Bridge Dental comes from its schema.org parentOrganization; the 'telehealth only' characterisation of HER Heart comes from its Psychology Today listing text; the township of CBROWN Barber Studio (NJ-34 Matawan) is unconfirmed.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable (blocked/timeout) from this environment, so no OSM cross-check of amenities was possible.

Direct fetches of several company and directory sites failed: dentalassociatesofoldbridge.com (connection error), profysionj.com (403), innerspacecounseling.com (5 MB response), yellowpages.com (403), massagebook.com (403), zencare.co (403). Details for those businesses come from search-returned renderings of the same pages and are flagged in the notes.
The Old Bridge-Sayreville-South Amboy Chamber of Commerce does not publish a public online member directory; it would have to be requested directly (out of scope for read-only research).
Booksy, Fresha and Google Maps listing pages block or JS-render results, so those inventories could not be harvested; barbers/salons remain the least complete category.
Bombshell Aesthetic Medical Spa and Innerspace Counseling could each be confirmed from only one or two sources (no own website opened), so triage should verify they are currently operating.
